name: Example: Converting From Polar Form to Cartesian Form
worked_solution:
We will simplify the right-hand side. Since $\cos\left(\dfrac{5\pi}{6}\right) = -\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$ and $\sin\left(\dfrac{5\pi}{6}\right) = \dfrac{1}{2},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}z & =4(\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{5\pi }{6})+\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{5\pi }{6})) \\  & =4(-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}+\text{i}\frac{1}{2}) \\  & =-2\sqrt{3}+2\text{i}.\end{aligned}
$$
